page_header.heading: About us
page_header.intro: A small, experienced team that cares about doing good work for good organisations.

story.heading: Our story
story.text:
Example Studio was set up to give growing organisations access to the kind of advice usually reserved for much larger companies.

We keep the team small on purpose, so clients always know who they are working with.

items.title: Listen first
items.text: Good advice starts with understanding the problem properly.

items.title: Keep it simple
items.text: Plain language and clear plans beat complexity every time.

items.title: Do the right thing
items.text: We only take on work we believe will make a real difference.

members.name: Alex Example
members.bio: Alex has 20 years of experience helping organisations plan for growth.

members.name: Sam Example
members.bio: Sam keeps projects on track and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.

cta.heading: Want to know more?
cta.text: We are always happy to have an informal conversation.
